system.omamori: You send a blast of divine energy towards a target within thirty yards multiplied by your Arcane Might, make a spellcasting attack roll and on a successful hit deal spirit damage equal to 2 * Arcane Might. This spell is only able to deal damage to supernatural creatures, such as spirits, or Yokai, and has no effect against regular mortals.
system.ofuda:
Release a wave of divine energy capable of destroying any corruption or dark magic over a ten yard area. Supernatural creatures of your choice in the area must make a basic Threat Rating roll against your spellcasting roll or take damage as if they had been hit by the lesser variant of this spell.

At Arcane Might III you may increase the radius of this ability up to a hundred yards, at Arcane Might V you may increase it to a thousand yards.
